preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 2**29 for x in xs)
preconditions.description: Each test case x is between 1 and 2^29 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((a > 0 and b > 0 and a <= 2**32 and b <= 2**32 and x == a ^ b and x == (a + b) / 2) or (result == -1) for x, (a, b, result) in zip(xs, results))
postconditions.description: For each test case x, either there exist positive integers a and b (both <= 2^32) such that x = a ⊕ b and x = (a + b) / 2, or the result is -1 indicating no such pair exists.
